title: The Fourth Possibility
next_chapter_hook: When Chen Ji touched upon that history deliberately erased by the Heavenly Dao, he heard his sister Chen Nian's cries—that sound came from a thousand years ago, sealed somewhere so deep that even the eyes of the Heavenly Dao could not peer into.

text.content: The ancient call surged into Chen Ji's Mental Sea like a tide. That voice, desolate and mournful, seemed to have traversed ten thousand years, only to resonate with his bloodline at this moment. 'Chen family son... you have finally come...' Chen Ji felt the blood throughout his body boiling. The Tianji Record Fragment materialized before his chest on its own, glowing with an eerie bronze light, echoing distantly with that bloodline voice.

dialogue.content: Cang Yutian stood with hands clasped behind his back beside the Axis of Fate, his expression changing drastically: 'How is this possible... you harbor such a thing within your bloodline!' A rare panic flickered in his eyes, the first expression of disbelief on his face that had remained unchanged for ten thousand years.

text.content: Chen Ji felt a burning sensation in his chest. That turtle shell artifact obtained from the secret realm flew out on its own, merging slowly with the Tianji Record Fragment. His consciousness was drawn into a chaotic Void, where countless intertwined threads of fate materialized around him—the three fates he had previously foreseen, with red, black, and purple threads intertwined, yet unable to break free from the axis of destiny.

dialogue.content: 'You think you can escape?' Cang Yutian's voice rang from the Void, carrying condescending mockery. 'The Tianji Record is merely a chess piece in my hands, and the Chen family bloodline is merely a selected tool. From the moment you were born, everything has been destined.'

text.content: However, Chen Ji's lips curved into a cold smile. As he stared at those threads, he suddenly discovered—beneath the red, black, and purple colors, there was also an almost invisible grayish-white strand, faint and obscure, as if deliberately diluted. 'Four possibilities...' he murmured. 'So even the Heavenly Dao fears the fourth answer.'

dialogue.content: Just then, a faint voice rang out in the depths of Chen Ji's consciousness: 'Brother... I'm here... I've been waiting for you for so long...' The voice was intermittent, as if separated by countless barriers of time and space—it was Chen Nian, his sister who had been missing for years!

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. He traced that grayish-white thread back to its source, yet discovered all the lines pointed in the same direction—the Chen family's First Generation Ancestral Hall, deliberately erased by the eyes of the Heavenly Dao. That place should have been destroyed in the long river of history ten thousand years ago, yet now it flickered in and out of view through his bloodline resonance.

choice.prompt: That grayish-white fourth possibility lies right before his eyes—the First Generation Ancestral Hall holds the key to breaking the Heavenly Dao's chess game. But Cang Yutian has already sensed the anomaly and is going all out to seal that path. How will you choose?

choices.text: Go All-In to Trace the Threads
choices.description: Spare no consumption of massive Heavenly Fate, forcibly tearing through the barriers of time and space with secret techniques to pursue that flickering First Generation Ancestral Hall.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the Complete Route Map of the Fourth Possibility
choices.risk_hint: Cang Yutian is setting up an inescapable net, and this move may play right into his hands

text.content: A resolute light flashed in Chen Ji's eyes, his Heavenly Fate burning furiously within. His form transformed into a streak of light, directly rushing toward the source of that grayish-white thread. Cang Yutian's expression changed drastically: 'Stop!' With a wave of his hand, countless laws of the Heavenly Dao manifested as chains, attempting to intercept Chen Ji.

choices.text: First Stabilize and Observe the Situation
choices.description: Do not act rashly, quietly observing the changes in that thread with the Tianji Record, seeking a safer opportunity to intervene.

text.content: Chen Ji suppressed his excitement, using the Tianji Record Fragment to carefully sense the fluctuations of that grayish-white thread. He discovered that although the thread was dissipating, it was still continuously releasing a faint call—as if waiting for something.

choices.text: Use Chen Nian's Voice as the Guide
choices.description: Since his sister's voice can penetrate the barriers of time and space, use her call as coordinates to precisely locate the First Generation Ancestral Hall.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain a safe passage that evades Heavenly Fate's surveillance
choices.risk_hint: The Ancient Existence's reactions are unpredictable

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, responding to that distant call with Bloodline Power. In an instant, a warm force surged from the depths of the Void, constructing an invisible bridge between him and Chen Nian.

Just then, a sigh echoed from the depths of the Void. That voice was ancient and weary, yet carried a trace of relief: 'Ten thousand years, and finally a Chen family son dares to gaze upon the fourth possibility...' Chen Ji felt his entire body tremble. The voice matched the call within his blood perfectly, yet ran far deeper, as if emanating from the Chen family's earliest origin.

dialogue.content: Cang Yutian's expression turned extremely gloomy: 'Chen family's First Ancestor... you actually still have remnant spirit remaining in this world!' An unusual hint of apprehension colored his voice. 'Back then, this one personally sealed you away. How could you possibly...'

text.content: That Ancient Existence's voice rang out once more, carrying ten thousand years of accumulated hatred: 'You sealed my fleshly body, yet cannot erase the memories inscribed within our bloodline. The fourth possibility is the only path to survival you left for the Chen family—and the flaw you can never erase.'

Before Chen Ji's eyes suddenly lit up. Within the seams of the Heavenly Fate's chess game, he finally saw the complete picture of the fourth possibility—it was neither escape nor confrontation, but... fusion. Using the Chen bloodline as the guide and the Tianji Record as the medium, integrating the Heavenly Eye's will with the will of all living beings, so that there would no longer be any distinction between chess player and chess piece.

dialogue.content: Cang Yutian burst into laughter, though within it lurked a hint of madness: 'Fusion? Do you know what price that demands!' He pointed at those gray-white threads. 'That is a road paved with the lives of ten thousand generations of the Chen family—your father, mother, clan members, even your sister, all shall become...'

choice.prompt: The price of the fourth possibility far exceeded imagination—it required the sacrifices of the Chen bloodline across generations to pave this road. But the Ancient Existence seemed to have more unspoken words...

choices.text: I am willing to bear any and all costs
choices.description: Since this was a road paved by ten thousand generations of Chen ancestors, he had no reason to retreat. Even if he himself became the final fuel, he would walk this path to its end.
choices.visible_cost: Risk losing everything, including Chen Nian
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the core method to break the Heavenly Fate chess game
choices.risk_hint: Cang Yutian is secretly laying a trap

text.content: Chen Ji knelt on both knees, bowing deeply toward the ancient existence in the Void: 'Chen Ji, thirty-seventh generation descendant of the Chen family, is willing to fill this ten-thousand-year gap with flesh and blood!' His voice echoed through the Void, heroic and resolute.

choices.description: The cost is too heavy. Before making a decision, one must clarify the complete truth of the fourth possibility—including Chen Nian's true role within it.
choices.visible_cost: Risk Cang Yutian seizing the initiative
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the complete truth about Chen Nian and the fourth possibility
choices.risk_hint: The Ancient Existence's patience is limited

text.content: Chen Ji forcefully suppressed the turmoil in his heart, asking in a low voice: 'Senior, please clarify—what role does Nian'er play on this road?' His voice trembled slightly, yet he maintained his composure.

choices.text: Cang Yutian, what are you afraid of?
choices.description: The Heavenly Eye is so wary of the fourth possibility; there must be something amiss. Why not probe Cang Yutian in reverse? Perhaps one can extract more information from his words.
choices.visible_reward: Capture the critical weakness from Cang Yutian's slip of the tongue

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly laughed, a smile that caused Cang Yutian to feel an inexplicable palpitation. He turned to face that eternally unchanging visage, leisurely saying: "The堂堂 mighty Eyes of Heavenly Dao,居然对一个残魂、一条被抹去的路如此忌惮……我倒想知道，你在怕什么？"

The ancient existence fell silent for a moment before speaking again: "The fourth possibility does not involve making the Chen family die……but rather turning the Chen bloodline into the key." As his words fell, the Turtle Shell artifact and the Tianji Record completely merged, presenting before Chen Ji a breathtaking vision—a door that had never been opened, inscribed with the names of the Chen family through ten thousand generations.

dialogue.content: Cang Yutian could no longer hold back, shouting sternly: "Enough!" With a wave of his hand, countless Heavenly Dao chains surged forth from the Void, rushing to sever the connection between Chen Ji and that ancient existence, "This one will not allow you to succeed! Ten thousand years ago I could seal you once; today I shall completely erase the Chen family's final hope!"

text.content: However, at this very moment, a clear voice pierced through the barriers of time and space: "Brother, I'm here." Chen Nian's figure flickered in and out of visibility in the Void—she was no longer the frail girl from memory, but a being bound by countless Heavenly Fate Chains—so it turned out she was not only the "key" but also the "lock" imprisoned by the Eyes of Heavenly Dao!

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji, do you see it?" Cang Yutian's voice regained its composure, "Your sister has been sealed here for a full twenty years. She is not your hope, but the final insurance of the Heavenly Dao's chess game—as long as she dies, everything returns to its original state. Dare you act?"

text.content: Chen Ji gazed upon that figure bound by chains, an upsurge of boundless hatred surging in his heart. Yet his gaze grew increasingly cold, so cold that even Cang Yutian felt a trace of unease. This man who was always scheming, at this moment was rapidly calculating in his heart—Chen Nian is the "lock," which means... the key to opening that door is to render the lock ineffective.

choice.prompt: The truth is revealed—Chen Nian is the final insurance of the Heavenly Dao's chess game; touching her causes everything to return to zero. But since that ancient existence dared to propose a fourth possibility, he must have a backup plan. How will you break this situation?

choices.text: Destroy the lock to rescue, break through to establish
choices.description: Directly destroy the chains binding Chen Nian, restoring her freedom. A chess game that has lost its "lock" will inevitably collapse, and at that time the Eyes of Heavenly Dao will also suffer backlash.
choices.visible_reward: Liberate Chen Nian, gain the initiative to confront the Eyes of Heavenly Dao
choices.risk_hint: Cang Yutian's true strength remains unknown

text.content: Chen Ji hesitated no more. He bit through his tongue, activating the full power of all Tianji Record fragments with his heart's blood. A brilliant radiance shot skyward, striking directly at the Heavenly Fate Chains binding Chen Nian!

choices.text: Please have the elder act first
choices.description: Since that ancient existence could survive to this day, he must have a backup plan. Better to let him first probe Cang Yutian's true cards, while I wait for my opportunity.
choices.visible_cost: May miss the golden opportunity to rescue
choices.visible_reward: Clearly see all the cards of both sides
choices.risk_hint: The ancient existence's patience has reached its limit

text.content: Chen Ji stepped back half a pace, respectfully saying: "Elder, you have schemed for ten thousand years; surely you have long made arrangements. Please extend your helping hand first and rescue my sister from peril." His tone was sincere, yet a calculating gleam flickered in the depths of his eyes.

choices.description: Though Cang Yutian is powerful, his fear of the fourth possibility is genuine. Attempt to use "revealing the truth of the Heavenly Dao's chess game" as a bargaining chip, engaging him in a grand gamble.
choices.visible_cost: Expose the critical intelligence I possess
choices.visible_reward: May gain breathing room or even an unexpected ally
choices.risk_hint: Cang Yutian may refuse to negotiate entirely

text.content: "Chen Ji stared directly into Cang Yutian's eyes and suddenly laughed: 'Did you think I didn't know? The Heavenly Dao's Eye is not invincible—you lost once ten thousand years ago.' With each word he spoke, Cang Yutian's expression grew more grim, 'Do you want to know who your opponent is?'"

"Cang Yutian's pupils contracted sharply. This was the first time in ten thousand years he showed genuine surprise—not contempt for Chen Ji, not disdain for the ancient existence, but actual shock. He stared at Chen Ji as if seeing this 'waste' for the first time: 'How could you possibly know about that...'"

dialogue.content: "'Did you think sealing me away was the end?' The ancient existence's voice carried ten thousand years of vengeful pleasure, 'Heavenly Dao's Eye, you've forgotten one thing—the one you betrayed ten thousand years ago never truly perished. He was merely waiting... waiting for a chess piece that could break this game.'"

text.content: "A crack suddenly split open in the void, and a massive eye emerged from the rift—this was not Cang Yutian's projection, but the true本体 of the Heavenly Dao's Eye! Its gaze swept over everyone present, finally fixing on Chen Ji, as if truly examining this ant for the first time."

dialogue.content: "'Chen family child...' The Heavenly Dao's Eye's voice was no longer Cang Yutian's relay, but rang directly through the void, 'You've touched upon a path that should not exist. But this One can give you a chance—hand over the Tianji Record, and this One grants you eternal reunion with your sister.'"

text.content: "Chen Ji gazed at that cold giant eye and suddenly burst into laughter. His laughter echoed through the void, filled with mockery and disdain: 'The Heavenly Dao's Eye? What arrogance. Ten thousand years ago you betrayed your ally to dominate the world, and now you want to threaten me with my sister?' His eyes flashed sharply, 'The fourth possibility is—to make you disappear from the chessboard entirely.'"

dialogue.content: "The Heavenly Dao's Eye fell silent for a moment, then erupted into earth-shaking laughter: 'Make this One disappear? Hahahaha! For billions of years, no one has ever dared such madness.' Its gaze turned ice-cold, 'Since you've chosen death, this One will oblige—starting with you, erasing the entire Chen family!'"

text.content: "Just as the Heavenly Dao's Eye prepared to unleash devastating attack, a sigh echoed from the depths of the void. It was the last remnant thought of the Chen family's ancient existence: 'Child, the true meaning of the fourth possibility... is not to make the Heavenly Dao disappear, but to awaken all living beings.' His voice grew weaker, 'The ultimate form of the Tianji Record... is to let everyone see their own destiny...'"

dialogue.content: "The Heavenly Dao's Eye shrieked in terror: 'Silence! You cannot tell him that secret!' It frantically descended Heavenly Dao power, attempting to stop the ancient existence's inheritance. Yet those gray-white threads suddenly blazed with light, weaving an unprecedented vision before Chen Ji—countless mortals gazing upward at the heavens, their eyes shimmering with the light of destiny."

text.content: "Chen Ji had a sudden realization. The core of the fourth possibility was not opposing the Heavenly Dao, not escaping fate, but—awakening. When all mortals could peer into Heavenly Secrets, could see their own futures, the Heavenly Dao's Eye could no longer monopolize the chess game, because then—everyone would be a player and a piece alike."

"'So that's how it is...' Chen Ji murmured, a flash of enlightenment in his eyes, 'The meaning of the Tianji Record was never about predicting the future, but about breaking the monopoly on destiny.' He glanced at the bound Chen Nian, then at the terrified Heavenly Dao's Eye, a smile curling at his lips—that smile of a master strategist who had everything under control."

dialogue.content: "The Heavenly Dao's Eye seemed to sense something, its voice trembling: 'You cannot do this... If all living beings could observe Heavenly Secrets, this world will be thrown into complete chaos!' Its tone was no longer a domineering threat, but... fear."

text.content: "'Chaos?' Chen Ji sneered, 'Compared to being manipulated as chess pieces for billions of years, what cost is that?' He slowly raised his hand, the Tianji Record Fragment and the Turtle Shell artifact completely merging, condensing into a brilliant point of light in his palm—the core of the fourth possibility, the seed of ten thousand people's Heavenly Secrets awakening."

dialogue.content: "The chains binding Chen Nian suddenly trembled violently. She gazed at her brother, eyes filled with tears yet bearing a smile: 'Brother, I feel it... twenty years, I've finally waited for this day.' Her voice, though weak, was exceptionally firm, 'Break it, let everyone see destiny—including themselves.'"

text.content: "Chen Ji gripped that point of light, feeling the earth-shattering power within. An unprecedented surge of ambition rose in his heart—at this moment, he would completely overturn the Heavenly Dao's chess game, bringing true transformation to this world. However, just then, he suddenly sensed something amiss—the ancient existence's voice seemed... deliberately concealing something."

"Chen Ji took a deep breath, his gaze profound as an abyss. He looked at the terrified Heavenly Dao's Eye, at the gradually dissipating ancient existence, and finally at his bound sister. A thought formed in his mind—the fourth possibility, though tempting, might there be deeper scheming within? His lips curved slightly upward, a dangerous cold light flickering in his eyes."

"'The fourth possibility, you say?' Chen Ji suddenly said softly, 'I accept it.' The moment his words fell, the entire void trembled. Yet just then, a cold voice rang in the depths of his consciousness—it was Mo Xiansheng, that mysterious existence who guarded the Tianji Record in remnant soul form: 'Master, please be cautious... The fourth possibility you witnessed is precisely the greatest trap the Heavenly Dao's Eye laid ten thousand years ago.'"

"Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. Mo Xiansheng's voice continued: 'The existence the Heavenly Dao's Eye betrayed ten thousand years ago was not the Chen family ancestor—it was himself. The Chen family ancestor who split into an independent personality was merely a tool created by the Heavenly Dao's Eye to fix loopholes in the chess game. The fourth possibility... is nothing but a deception making the chess piece willingly walk to the altar.'"

dialogue.content: "Mo Xiansheng's voice echoed in Chen Ji's consciousness: 'The true method to break the局, not within the fourth possibility, but in the fifth choice the Tianji Record has never shown—letting the Heavenly Dao's Eye reunite with its split personality, returning to complete will. At that time, it will no longer be a domineering chess player, but a flawed... human being.'"

text.content: "Chen Ji felt his mind explode. All the clues connected at this moment—the Chen family bloodline's curse, the Tianji Record's incompleteness, the alluring facade of the fourth possibility, and that flash of... pain and struggle in the Heavenly Dao's Eye's gaze. It was not pure evil, but a fragmented will unable to unify!"

"'So that's it...' Chen Ji murmured, confusion in his eyes gradually replaced by clarity, 'The fifth choice—letting the fragmented reunite.' He gazed at Cang Yutian whose face showed terror, and at the enraged Heavenly Dao's Eye, a meaningful smile curling at his lips, 'It seems this chess game... is even more complex than I thought.'"
